_comment: Static reference pricing for cost estimation only — not live AWS pricing. On-demand Linux hourly rates for common instance families across the regions this app's seed/demo data uses. Extend as needed; unresolvable lookups return priceKnown=false rather than guessing. Regenerate with scripts/generate-instance-pricing.ps1 (AWS Price List API and describe-instance-types); instanceTypes holds vCPU, memory and architecture per type, generationUpgradeMap the newer-generation target per architecture (E30-T02). rdsPricing holds RDS rates per engine, DB class, region and deployment (Multi-AZ is twice Single-AZ) and rdsStorageGbMonthRate the RDS gp3 storage rate (E33-T05); the us-east-1 RDS rates were entered by hand from the list prices until the script is run with -Rds.
